title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 AUGUST 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 11 August 2026. Showers will occur at times in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Several spells of showers may occur in Western and North-western provinces. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and eastern provinces and in Mullaitivu district after 2.00 p.m. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
